visual_paradigm.recognition_anchor: Role-based component cards distinguish generation agents, the rendering–refinement loop, and shared expertise memory.
visual_paradigm.boundary_check: Preserve the upstream role tiers and feedback dependencies so the figure reads as a system architecture rather than a linear flowchart.
visual_paradigm.container_visibility_audit: Structure declares no groups or explicit boundaries; do not introduce layer frames.
visual_paradigm.role_hierarchy: Generation agents are primary, rendering and memory are shared infrastructure, and experience workers support knowledge evolution.
visual_paradigm.parent_first_surface_logic: No containment surfaces are required; apply consistent component-card styling.
topological_invariants: Preserve Structure Agent → Style Agent → Layout Agent order.
Preserve both rendering–refinement directions as separate edges.
Preserve experience search → distillation → memory and retrieval by all three generation agents.
Preserve all upstream IDs, labels, roles, sublabels, and relationships without adding groups.

shape_and_icon_system.card_treatment: Light solid fill, paired family border, clean outline icon, component name, and supporting sublabel.
shape_and_icon_system.icon_policy: Retain Structure's component icons; use the assigned node stroke color for each icon.

color_and_stroke_system.role_mapping: Teal identifies coordinating agents, blue-gray identifies input and shared infrastructure, and seafoam identifies knowledge support and editable output.
color_and_stroke_system.edge_policy: All edges use border_default; edge entries contain color only.

typography_and_hierarchy.emphasis_policy: Bold identifies generation agents, the render engine, and shared expertise memory; sublabels remain regular.
typography_and_hierarchy.label_policy: Preserve all component names and sublabels verbatim.
